key_results: ACER of 4.33% on UFPR-Close-Up dataset; outperforms recent active liveness models across four evaluation protocols
comments: New dataset contribution is valuable, but evaluation limited to in-house data; generalization to other datasets unclear.

inputs: video frames of close-up facial movements

hypotheses.hypothesis: Combining distortion features with spatial embeddings improves active liveness detection
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; achieved 4.33% ACER, best among recent methods

title: Acoustic deep learning for defect detection in aluminium wheel rims
task: Acoustic deep learning for structural defect detection in aluminum wheel rims
key_results: RimNet (STFT + CNN + domain filtering + hard-negative mining) achieves 96.9% file-level accuracy, zero wheel-level misclassifications on 930 samples; uncertainty quantification reveals defect-type patterns
comments: Practical application with strong performance and uncertainty analysis; microphone-only acquisition is deployment-friendly, but generalization to other wheel types/materials not explored.

outputs: margins, entropy, Brier score, energy-based uncertainty estimates

hypotheses.hypothesis: Acoustic deep learning with uncertainty quantification detects structural defects in wheel rims with high confidence
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 96.9% accuracy with clear uncertainty patterns for defect types

title: A hybrid CNN–LSTM approach for large-scale Twitter sentiment analysis with explainable artificial intelligence
task: Twitter sentiment classification via hybrid CNN-LSTM with interpretability
key_results: CNN-LSTM achieves 97.73% accuracy, 97.74% precision, 96.73% recall, F1=97.73% on 690K balanced tweets; SHAP reveals sentiment-relevant word drivers; outperforms CNN, LSTM, Bi-LSTM baselines
comments: Strong empirical results and SHAP interpretability, but evaluation limited to English tweets; generalization to sarcasm, domain shifts, or multilingual data not addressed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CNN-LSTM hybrid model captures local and sequential sentiment patterns better than single-architecture models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 97.73% accuracy outperforms all baselines

title: Algorithm–hardware co-design of neuromorphic networks with dual memory pathways
task: Algorithm-hardware co-design for long-sequence spiking neural networks with dual memory pathways
key_results: Dual memory pathway SNN achieves competitive accuracy with 40-60% fewer params than state-of-the-art; near-memory-compute architecture yields 4.1x throughput and 5.1x energy efficiency improvements
comments: Elegant bio-inspired architecture balancing algorithmic and hardware efficiency; strong results but limited to benchmark sequences; real-world event-driven sensing and on-device learning validation pending.

model_io.model: Dual memory pathway SNN (fast spiking + slow contextual state)

inputs: sparse spike and dense memory data flows

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dual memory pathway architecture inspired by cortical fast-slow dynamics improves efficiency and accuracy
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; 40-60% param reduction with competitive accuracy; 5.1x energy efficiency gain

title: Public reactions to hospitals after adverse events involving AI
task: Public accountability attribution for AI-involved hospital adverse events
key_results: Participants attributed higher responsibility to hospitals and greater likelihood of complaint/legal action following AI-involved adverse events vs. physician-alone; interactive AI collaboration attenuated negative reactions
comments: Novel behavioral study quantifying public trust dynamics; limited sample size and generalization to other stakeholders (providers, insurers) unclear; lacks mechanistic insight into trust repair.

hypotheses.hypothesis: AI involvement in adverse events increases public attribution of hospital responsibility relative to physician-alone scenarios
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; participants reported higher complaint likelihood and legal action for AI-involved events

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interactive AI-physician collaboration reduces negative public reactions compared to AI-alone involvement
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; negative reactions attenuated in collaborative scenarios

title: Electron pressure drives THz phonons in metal–metal superlattices
task: Elucidate electron-pressure-driven terahertz lattice oscillations in metal-metal superlattice metamaterials
key_results: Pt/Cu superlattices exhibit large-amplitude 1 THz coherent strain oscillations driven by electron pressure (not phonon stress); mechanism engineerable via pitch and material composition; enables ultrafast strain-mediated spintronic devices
comments: Novel thermoacoustic metamaterial mechanism using electron pressure instead of phonon stress; combines femtosecond X-ray diffraction with DFT and two-temperature modeling for strong experimental validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electron pressure, not phonon stress, is the dominant actuation mechanism for THz lattice oscillations in metal superlattices
hypotheses.result: Mode-resolved DFT and two-temperature modeling confirm electron pressure drives 1 THz oscillation in Pt/Cu; mechanism tunable by structure

title: Hybrid integration of quantum dot single-photon sources with lithium tantalate photonics for on-chip routing
task: Demonstrate hybrid integration of quantum-dot single-photon sources with lithium tantalate photonics for on-chip routing
key_results: InAs QD-LTOI hybrid chip achieves low-loss reconfigurable waveguides (0.30 ± 0.04 dB/cm at 900 nm); deterministic single-photon routing with half-wave voltage-length product ~1.9 V·cm at 4 K; robust alignment-tolerant inter-waveguide coupling via tapered butt-coupling
comments: Strong integration of efficient single-photon sources with low-loss reconfigurable photonics via micro-transfer printing; cryogenic operation requirement may limit practical deployment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: LTOI electro-optic coefficient remains stable and effective at cryogenic temperatures
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; half-wave voltage-length product ~1.9 V·cm at 4 K demonstrates cryogenic stability

title: String-sliding vibrational modes govern the boson peak and phonon anomalies in amorphous materials
task: Identify microscopic origin of the boson peak via string-sliding vibrational mode resonance with phonons
key_results: String-sliding modes resonate with phonons at terahertz frequencies to generate boson-peak excess; boson peak persists without quasi-localized modes or elastic heterogeneity; unified mode-based framework established for 2D/3D ordinary, hyperuniform, and unstressed glasses
comments: Resolves decades-old mystery by showing resonance mechanism (rather than quasi-localized modes) drives boson peak; simulations across multiple glass types strengthen universality claim.

model_io.model: Molecular dynamics simulations of glasses (ordinary, hyperuniform, unstressed in 2D/3D)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Boson peak arises from quasi-localized modes or elastic heterogeneity
hypotheses.result: Disproven; boson peak persists even without quasi-localized modes or heterogeneity

hypotheses.hypothesis: String-phonon resonance at terahertz frequencies generates boson-peak excess
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; resonant coupling via frequency matching is central microscopic mechanism

title: Structural, dielectric, and radiation shielding properties of erbium doped phosphate glasses
task: Characterize structural, dielectric, and radiation-shielding properties of erbium-doped phosphate glasses
key_results: Density increases with Er2O3 substitution; Er-linked cross-bridges lower non-bridging-oxygen concentration at ≤0.5 mol% Er2O3; dielectric constant and AC conductivity minimum at 0.5 mol% (optimal packing density); Er-1.0 sample provides maximum gamma-ray shielding; build-up factors calculated for 0.015–15 MeV and 0.5–40 mfp
comments: Comprehensive characterization with potential medical/industrial radiation-shielding applications, though mechanical properties and long-term stability not addressed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Cross-linking at low Er2O3 doping reduces dielectric and conductivity properties
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; ε′ and σac decline at 0.25 and 0.5 mol% Er2O3, minimum at 0.5 mol%

title: Computational carrier dynamics across heterojunction interface between hole injection and transport layers in quantum-dot light-emitting diodes
task: Develop field-dependent discretization scheme to stabilize carrier transport across heterojunction interfaces in QD-LEDs
key_results: Field-dependent current density scheme suppresses numerical instabilities at abrupt heterojunctions; model reproduces voltage-dependent trends in current density, luminance, and external quantum efficiency; enables analysis of energy-level alignment and acceptor-doping effects on carrier injection
comments: Physics-based approach addresses genuine numerical stability challenge in drift-diffusion at heterojunctions; broadly applicable to multilayer semiconductor devices beyond QD-LEDs.

model_io.model: Drift-diffusion charge transport model for QD-LED with field-dependent discretization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Field-dependent current density scheme stabilizes discretization at heterojunction interfaces
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; scheme suppresses mean-value interpolation artifacts and enables convergent simulation

title: Improving quantum-battery charging via unidirectional quantum jumps to metastable state
task: Improve quantum battery charging by suppressing detrimental quantum jumps to metastable states
key_results: Three-level Λ-configuration atoms with restricted spontaneous transitions (excited→metastable only) achieve fully charged state with extractable energy; charging protocol duration shortened in second stage
comments: Clever use of metastable states to convert quantum jumps from detrimental to constructive, but scalability and coherence maintenance at longer timescales need experimental validation.

model_io.model: Three-level atomic ensemble in Λ configuration
inputs: charging protocol with restricted quantum transitions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Restricting spontaneous transitions to excited→metastable pathway makes quantum jumps constructive for charging
hypotheses.result: Quantum jumps drive system to fully charged state with entire stored energy extractable; second-stage duration reduced

title: Benchmarking machine learning approaches for polarization mapping in ferroelectrics using 4D-STEM
task: Benchmark machine learning models for automated polarization direction detection in 4D-STEM ferroelectric data
key_results: ResNet, VGG, custom CNN, and PCA-k-NN tested; synthetic-data-trained models achieve high accuracy on idealized patterns but domain gap between simulation and experiment remains critical barrier; PCA methods combined with augmentation show promise for real-world deployment
comments: Identifies periodic misclassification correlating with crystal defects, suggesting supervised models could double as defect detectors, but real-world reliability still unproven.

model_io.model: ResNet, VGG, custom CNN, PCA-k-NN classifiers
inputs: 4D-STEM diffraction patterns from potassium sodium niobate

hypotheses.hypothesis: ML models trained on synthetic diffraction patterns transfer to experimental data
hypotheses.result: Domain gap remains critical barrier; PCA-based methods with augmentation partially bridge gap but real-world reliability unconfirmed

hypotheses.hypothesis: Model prediction irregularities correlate with structural defects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed qualitatively; suggests potential for defect detection via supervised learning

title: In-situ SEM evaluation of single-nanowire response in CuO–Cu₂O–ZnO nanowire arrays for infrared energy harvesting

comments: In-situ SEM nanomanipulation provides direct measurement at single-nanowire level; photo-thermoelectric response to IR opens potential for low-temperature-difference power generation in wearables.

hypotheses.hypothesis: CuO-Cu2O-ZnO nanowires exhibit unbiased response to infrared radiation via photo-thermoelectric effect

key_results: Conductive-fabric-PDMS antenna achieves three frequency bands at 3.5, 5.15, 6.6 GHz; conformal analysis shows good S11, gain, efficiency agreement; SAR and on-body gain validated on human phantom
comments: Comprehensive characterization including SAR analysis demonstrates suitability for wearables, though mechanical durability under repeated bending and washing cycles not explicitly addressed.

title: Identification of the mode, polarization, wavelength and intensity of light using a one-pixel device on an optical fibre tip
task: Develop one-pixel fiber-tip device for simultaneous four-dimensional light detection (mode, polarization, wavelength, intensity)
key_results: Black phosphorus/black arsenic-phosphorus dichroic layers with ring-grating electrodes generate six distinct photoresponses; achieves four-dimensional light detection with ~10⁴ recognizable input-state space in one-shot measurement; enables multidimensional image encryption communication
comments: Clever use of 2D material anisotropy and spatial electrode patterning to extract multiple light parameters from single pixel; miniaturization on fiber tip suitable for in-situ monitoring in telecommunications.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Anisotropic 2D materials with spatial electrode patterns can simultaneously resolve multiple light parameters from single-pixel measurement

title: Modular Scalable Synthetic Gene Circuits for Complex Functions Within Minimal Computational Layers in Human Cells
task: Design scalable mammalian gene circuits with reduced computational layers
key_results: Engineered complex circuits including full adders and 3-to-1 multiplexers within minimal layers; reduced genetic payload and resource depletion compared to cascaded architectures
comments: The trans-splicing AND gates and synthetic microRNA logic offer elegant modularity, though mammalian circuit reliability and cell-to-cell variability remain practical concerns for therapeutic deployment.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Reducing computational layers while maintaining functionality enables scalable circuit design
hypotheses.result: Successfully implemented three-input logic, half/full adders, and multiplexers with fewer layers than cascaded approaches

hypotheses.result: Platform demonstrated complex combinatorial and arithmetic logic functions with reduced orthogonal parts
